title: What If You Drove a Car Faster Than Sound?

scenes.text: What if you drove a car faster than sound? One man did. Nothing about it was normal.
On October fifteenth, nineteen ninety-seven, Andy Green drove ThrustSSC across a Nevada desert at seven hundred sixty-three miles an hour.
Two jet engines from a fighter plane pushed it. It burned about five gallons of fuel every second.
The car broke the sound barrier on the ground. Two sonic booms rolled across the desert, though the driver couldn't hear them.
Green said that at five hundred miles an hour, the car was a massive handful, bordering on uncontrollable.
It's still the only car ever to go supersonic. Every record before it, and since, has stayed under the speed of sound.

description:
What if you drove a car faster than sound?
In 1997, ThrustSSC hit 763 mph in the Nevada desert, powered by two fighter-jet engines, and it is still the only supersonic car.
